RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 40

Do not raise the panel's gender composition with the bank. Doing so will put the employer on the defensive, shut down communication, and ruin your chances of receiving constructive feedback or future consideration.

An all-male panel reflects poor diversity and risks unconscious affinity bias, but it does not prove discrimination. For a department head, broad regulatory experience is a legitimate, highly valued qualification that often outweighs technical modeling depth.

Two weeks is a normal corporate delay. Send a polite, professional follow-up requesting your feedback. Only consider raising bias if you uncover concrete evidence of discrimination and have consulted an employment lawyer.
